description: CLK0 (6m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) through 12 cm of pigtail, a 9-pole Chebyshev low-pass filter and a measured 38 dB pad set

chain.name: 12 cm pigtail from the Si5351 board to the filter
chain.notes: moves the filter away from the board to reduce high-frequency coupling; the same pigtail as used on 2m; type not recorded

chain.name: 9-pole Chebyshev low-pass
chain.notes: cutoff 64 MHz; home built; loses about 3.7 dB at 51 MHz

chain.name: pad set
chain.notes: measured, not the labels: a BNC attenuator marked 10 dB (really 27 dB) in series with a home-built 27-33-27 ohm T pad (15 dB), joined with SMA/BNC adapters. Measured together without the filter on 2026-10-31 as 37.9 dB at 51 MHz (36.9 to 38.4 dB from 20 to 180 MHz).

notes: Compare with 6m-chebyshev-lpf-64MHz-38dB (the same chain without the pigtail). Same filter, pad set, cable and adapters; only the pigtail is added. The pad value is a measured loss between the Si5351 side and the analyser, taken as the drop from a straight cable (with the same adapters) at 2 mA. The attenuator labelled 10 dB is also the pad used in the 70cm baseline; its real loss there has not been measured at 435 MHz.
